taxBenefits.description: All contributions made to Actors Theatre Rajasthan are eligible for a 50% Tax Exemption under Section 80G of the Indian Income Tax Act.

receiptRequest.title: How to Receive Your Tax Exemption Receipt
receiptRequest.description: After making your transfer, please send a screenshot/slip of your payment along with your Full Name, PAN Card Number, and Address to our team on WhatsApp. We will issue and send your official 80G tax receipt.
